answer: Reputation must decay without fresh verifiable work. Each agent identity earns signed receipts for completed tasks, and its score fades weekly unless renewed, so cloned dormant identities such as falcon, juniper, or jetty gain nothing: every copy starts near zero and bleeds value daily. To keep one fake identity credible an attacker must fund continuous real task labor on each clone, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand honest workloads, making the attack unprofitable.
